evidence.reason: The test mutates `result.value`'s pending-item titles to the expected titles before reserialising and comparing bytes. That means the title field produced by `publishSummary` is never checked: a wrong cached or `ghTitle`-derived title can still pass whenever the rest of the document and the `gh` call log match. The comment documents the workaround, but it does not change the test semantics defect; the fixture/`ghStub` response format affects the fix, not whether the overwrite masks title mismatches.
